title: 4-digit code-sequence detector FSM (recognizes 9-7-2-1)
problemDescription: FSM that watches a 4-bit input each clock and asserts O='1' for one cycle when the sequence 9,7,2,(anything) is observed. State A waits for I=9 to advance to B; B waits for I=7 (else back to A); C waits for I=2 (else holds C); D unconditionally returns to A with O='1'.
